projects.title: Cassava Leaf Disease Detection
projects.description:
Currently, working on different models for classifying 5-types of leaf diseases on Image Data as a part of Cassava Leaf Disease Classification Competition on Kaggle.
Project is still under work.

projects.title: Melanoma Cancer Detection
projects.description:
I was working to classify skin images that have melanoma cancer vs ones that don't. This was particulary a hard challenge as the data was highly imbalanced.
At the end, I achieved a Validation Accuracy of ~78%.

projects.title: Pneumonia Classification
projects.description:
I have trained a Deep CNN to classify weather a Chest XRay Image has Pneumonia or not. Along with the model trainng, I have also done In-depth Image Analysis, EDA of the Dataset and deployed a Web Application for the same.
Link to the Web App.
